items.label: Elevate your style with the latest befen cell phone crossbody
items.value: a sleek and functional accessory crafted from soft, durable real leather. Experience the perfect blend of organization and security with RFID protection against digital theft. Versatile and fashionable, it effortlessly complements any outfit

items.label: Stay impeccably organized with our triple pocket design
items.value: a convenient magnetic front flap pocket for quick phone access (fits devices up to 6.9 inches), a double pocket middle section with top zip closure and 3 RFID blocking card slots, and an exterior zipper pocket at the back. Keep essentials like your cell phone, sunglasses, lip gloss, credit cards all securely in place

items.label: Compact yet versatile
items.value: this lightweight shoulder bag measures 5"(L) x 8"(H) x 2"(W) with an adjustable leather strap (12 to 25" drop). Seamlessly switch between crossbody and shoulder wear as needed. Offering more space than our regular phone crossbody, this chic and practical bag accommodates your daily essentials with ease

items.label: The perfect gift choice
items.value: Impress your loved ones with the elegant design and functional features of befen leather crossbody purses for women. Ideal for occasions like Mother's Day, birthdays, anniversaries, Christmas, or Thanksgiving. Whether you're out running errands, traveling, or enjoying a night out, this designer handbag is a reliable companion for all your must-haves

items.label: Experience exceptional product service with befen
items.value: a brand trusted by millions for its premium leather goods and customer satisfaction. If you haven't experienced our leather crossbody before, give this one a try. You'll soon discover why our customers love it

items.label: Product Care Instructions
items.value: Avoid water and direct sunlight. Spot clean with a damp cloth. Condition leather periodically. Do not machine wash.
